arguments.title: 야 야 야옹! 멍 멍 멍멍! | 모모타임
arguments.lyrics:
[Chorus - sung from the first beat; crisp short-short-long motif]
야, 야, 야옹!
고양이!
멍, 멍, 멍멍!
강아지!
야, 야, 야옹!
고양이!
멍, 멍, 멍멍!
강아지!

[Clap refrain - small pauses; keep dancing]
야옹! 짝!
멍멍! 짝!
야옹! 멍멍!
짝짝짝!

[Chorus - exact same tune and rhythm]
야, 야, 야옹!
고양이!
멍, 멍, 멍멍!
강아지!
야, 야, 야옹!
고양이!
멍, 멍, 멍멍!
강아지!

[Clap refrain - bass drops out, claps keep the pulse]
야옹! 짝!
멍멍! 짝!
야옹! 멍멍!
짝짝짝!

[Final chorus - bass returns; exact same melody, not faster]
야, 야, 야옹!
고양이!
멍, 멍, 멍멍!
강아지!
야, 야, 야옹!
고양이!
멍, 멍, 멍멍!
강아지!

[Ending - same tune, final chord]
고양이! 강아지!
짝짝짝!
[End]
arguments.style: Korean preschool dance-pop, bright light youthful female solo, clear natural singing. 120 BPM, four-on-the-floor soft kick, snappy handclaps, bouncy octave synth bass, playful marimba. The VOCAL HOOK is the star: two clipped repeated notes then a longer rising-and-resolving note, a tiny four-note melody. Sing each short lyric line over a whole bar, leave a clear breath before the next; never squeeze two lines into one bar. Animal-sound line calls, animal-name line answers. Identical catchy tune each chorus. The clap refrain drops the bass for four bars while claps continue; bass returns strongly on the chorus. Simple sung rhythm for toddlers, energetic accompaniment, obvious contrast. No intro, no instrumental break. About 75 seconds, finish on the final sung clap with a short chord.
